note: Scenarios the campaign runner can execute. Every entry must correspond to something that actually exists: a recorded replay on disk, or a probe the binary implements. Nothing here is invented from memory. Overlay numbers come from include/ovl_table.h, board identities from src/game/board/main.c:137, board names from the BOARD_ID_ comments in include/game/board/main.h, and minigame names and types from src/REL/selmenuDll/main.c and src/game/objsub.c.

scenarios.description: The first two minutes of the recorded session: boot, the mode select and menu overlays, and the entry onto the board. Short enough to be the gate a change has to pass before a long campaign is worth starting.
Recorded human session on the w04 board: four minigames, four returns through the results screen, the Big Boo event that used to overflow a coroutine stack at frame 48671.

The same recording, stopped just past the fourth unload of the results screen. This is the D3 window: overlay 84 is torn down at frames 18141, 27744, 34604 and 43970, and the invalid ADPCM read has only ever been seen on one of those frames. Short enough to be repeated twenty times.

The walking recording, which is the only one that reaches a second board. Boot, mode select twice, the entry menu, then w01Dll at frame 5385, the minigame instructions and m408Dll SKY DIVE at 14090. Shorter than the w04 session and the only coverage this project has outside Boo's Haunted Bash.
scenarios.minigame: m408Dll SKY DIVE (overlay 16, type 0, four players)
